scope: Local exploratory Broad transfer; no scientific-owner acceptance claimed
cohort_selection: Frozen qualification pool; passing Humagne-CD 3DO, non-cancerous excluded, absent historical identity graph, RNA listed; lowest ModelID per component
feature_eligibility: All 30 expression genes present and finite for the model; no external imputation; same cohort for all model families
primary: Unweighted mean over all 12 targets of Spearman(compact pair, response) minus Spearman(strong expression baseline, response)
primary_unsupported_rule: Primary estimate unavailable if any target has <30 responses or undefined pair/strong correlation; do not omit targets
bootstrap_rule: Same recorded identity resamples across all targets; average-rank ties; CI only if >=95% of draws support all 12 contrasts
secondary: Per-target/lineage rank correlation; raw MSE diagnostic; no individual significance or discovery claims
model_selection: Development-only inner MSE selection, existing tuning grids; no new external tuning
holdout_policy: Broad is exploratory once opened. No Sanger outcomes loaded, tuned or scored. Literature summaries already read.
source_policy: Exact manuscript inputs and local-research reuse terms required; do not silently substitute 26Q3 or analytical summaries
scientific_review: Pending; this local exploratory trial does not certify confirmation or public readiness
